note: At 0-0 the designated first server serves from the right court.
A singles server retains service after winning a rally.
An even server score uses the right court; the next odd score uses left.
An odd server score uses the left court; the next even score uses right.
A receiving player takes service after winning the rally.
The new singles server serves from the court matching the new odd score.
A singles server at an odd score keeps service and moves to right after scoring.
Service passes to team 0 when team 1 loses its service rally.
The opening server occupies right court and the receiver is diagonally opposite.
The same doubles server serves again from left after a serving-side point.
On the next serving-side point, that same server alternates back to right.
Service passes to the receiver already standing left at an odd score.
When the receiving side reaches an even score, its right-court partner serves.
The receiving pair's positions remain fixed when the server's side wins.
A serving-side player moves courts while the receiving pair stays put.
A team 1 first server also starts from right court at 0-0.
Team 1's odd-score server is in left while the partner stays in right.
If team 1 takes service at an odd score, the left-court player becomes server.
If team 0 takes service at an odd score, the left-court player becomes server.
The new serving side's unchanged positions select the even-score right player.
The server keeps serving at an even score while its partner moves to left.
At 20-all, the first point makes 21-20 and does not end the game.
At 20-all, team 1's first point makes 20-21 and does not end the game.
A two-point lead at 22-20 wins after 21-20.
The 21-20 side does not win if the opponent makes it 21-all.
At 21-all, one point makes 22-21 but is not yet a win.
At 22-21, the next point creates a two-point win at 23-21.
At 28-all, 29-28 is still live.
At 28-29, a team 0 point creates 29-all rather than a win.
At 29-28, 30-28 is a two-point win.
At 29-all, team 0's 30th point wins 30-29.
At 29-all, team 1's 30th point wins 29-30.
A 21-19 first-game score ends the game and changes ends.
The first game's winner serves first in game two.
A second game for the first game's winner completes the match at two games.
When game two ties the match, ends change before the third game.
The winner of game two serves first when the third game begins.
In the third game, the first side to reach 11 changes ends.
Ends stay changed on rallies after the third-game 11-point interval.
Team 1 can close a match by winning its second game.
A 30-29 score ends the game at the cap.
A single completed game is not enough to end a best-of-three match.
The second game's end change happens after a 1-1 score, before game three.
Undo restores the exact prior state after one confirmed rally point.
A point cannot be applied after one side has won two games.
